Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

There's an Indonesian woman and a Nigerian woman who work at desks right next to each other. They get along really well, but the women are pretty different from each other. The Indonesian woman is soft spoken, shy, and never confronts anyone, even when the other person is clearly in the wrong. The Nigerian woman, on the other hand, speaks her mind pretty freely. She's not aggressive, but people definitely know where they stand with her. Who is very docile?
A. The Indonesian woman
B. The Nigerian woman
C. Undetermined
